name: amazon/fresh
description: Search Amazon Fresh grocery products for a delivery ZIP code, with title, price, unit price, rating and availability.

k.description: Parameter defines the query you want to search. You can use anything that you would use in a regular Amazon Fresh search. This parameter can't be used with the `node` parameter.

s.description: Parameter is used for sorting results. It defaults to `relevanceblender` (Featured). Available options: `relevanceblender` - Featured `price-asc-rank` - Price: Low to High `price-desc-rank` - Price: High to Low `review-rank` - Avg. Customer Review `date-desc-rank` - Newest Arrivals `exact-aware-popularity-rank` - Best Sellers

dc.description: Parameter defines the exclusion of results from an auto-corrected query when the original query is spelled wrong. It can be set to `true` to exclude these results, or `false` to include them (default).

rh.description: Parameter defines items filtering based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key:value` pairs separated by `,`. For example `n:16318981,p_n_program_participation:17428820011` to filter for products in the **Fresh Fruits** department (`n:16318981`) that are **SNAP EBT Eligible** (`p_n_program_participation:17428820011`) on `amazon.com`. Use `p_36:<min>-<max>` for a price range, with prices multiplied by 100 (e.g., `p_36:300-500` for $3.00 to $5.00). Available filters depend on the query and are returned in `filters`, along with a `the API_link` to apply each of them.

node.description: Parameter defines the Amazon Fresh department to browse without a search query. For example, `16318981` for **Fresh Fruits** on `amazon.com`. Department IDs are the `n:` values in `filters.department[].rh` (e.g., `n:16318981`). To switch departments while browsing, change `node` or follow the department's `the API_link`: Amazon ignores departments in `rh` while `node` is set. This parameter can't be used with the `k` parameter.

page.description: Parameter defines the page number. It's used for pagination. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.).

device.description: Parameter defines the device to use to get the results. It can be set to `desktop` (default) to use a regular browser, `tablet` to use a tablet browser (currently using iPads), or `mobile` to use a mobile browser.

language.description: Parameter defines the language to use for the Amazon Fresh search. It's a locale name represented as <language>_<REGION>. (e.g., on amazon.com `en_US` for English, `es_US` for Spanish, or on amazon.co.jp `ja_JP` for Japanese). Head to Amazon languages for a full list of supported Amazon languages.

delivery_zip.description: Parameter defines the ZIP or postal code of the delivery location. Amazon Fresh shows the products, prices, and delivery options available at that location. For example, `10001` on `amazon.com`, `EC1A 1BB` on `amazon.co.uk`, or `100-0001` on `amazon.co.jp`. ZIP+4 codes aren't supported.

amazon_domain.description: Parameter defines the Amazon domain to use. It defaults to `amazon.com`. Amazon Fresh is available on `amazon.com`, `amazon.co.uk`, `amazon.co.jp`, `amazon.it`, and `amazon.es`.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

# Amazon Fresh Search

Search Amazon Fresh grocery products for a delivery ZIP code, with title, price, unit price, rating and availability.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/amazon/fresh" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"k": "milk", "delivery_zip": "10001"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

| `dc` | string | No | Parameter defines the exclusion of results from an auto-corrected query when the original query is spelled wrong. It can be set to `true` to exclude these results, or `false` to include them (default). |
